title: Table of Contents
slide_intent: Make a long guide easy to navigate so readers can find the rule that answers their immediate question.
strategic_value: A categorized contents page can make T-Mobile standards easier to consult during production.
demonstration: Three columns list strategy, core elements, typography, copy, visual guidance and resources with page numbers.
practical_value: Choose the relevant section before searching through individual examples.
